passages.text: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Lilies.” A Maskil of the sons of Korah. A love song.
passages.sermon:
This song is for the choirmaster.
The song uses the tune called “The Lilies.”
The sons of Korah wrote this song.
This song is a Maskil, which means it teaches wisdom.
This song is a love song.

passages.text: My heart is stirred by a noble theme as I recite my verses to the king; my tongue is the pen of a skillful writer.
passages.sermon:
The sons of Korah wrote this song.
They wrote it for the choirmaster.
They set it to the tune called “The Lilies.”
This song is a Maskil, which means it teaches wisdom.
This song is a love song.
My heart feels a good and noble theme.
I speak my verses to the king.
My tongue works like the pen of a skillful writer.
passages.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ עַל־ שֹׁ֭שַׁנִּים לִבְנֵי־ קֹ֑רַח מַ֝שְׂכִּ֗יל שִׁ֣יר יְדִידֹֽת׃ רָ֘חַ֤שׁ לִבִּ֨י׀ דָּ֘בָ֤ר ט֗וֹב אֹמֵ֣ר אָ֭נִי מַעֲשַׂ֣י לְמֶ֑לֶךְ לְ֝שׁוֹנִ֗י עֵ֤ט׀ סוֹפֵ֬ר מָהִֽיר׃

passages.text: You are the most handsome of men; grace has anointed your lips, since God has blessed you forever.
passages.sermon: The king is the most handsome of all men.\r\nGrace fills the king’s lips.\r\nGod has blessed the king forever.
passages.original: יָפְיָפִ֡יתָ מִבְּנֵ֬י אָדָ֗ם ה֣וּצַק חֵ֭ן בְּשְׂפְתוֹתֶ֑יךָ עַל־ כֵּ֤ן בֵּֽרַכְךָ֖ אֱלֹהִ֣ים לְעוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: Strap your sword at your side, O mighty warrior; appear in your majesty and splendor.
passages.sermon:
The psalmist speaks to a mighty warrior.
The psalmist calls the warrior strong and powerful.
The psalmist commands the warrior to strap his sword at his side.
The psalmist tells the warrior to show his majesty.
The psalmist tells the warrior to display his splendor.
passages.original: חֲגֽוֹר־ חַרְבְּךָ֣ עַל־ יָרֵ֣ךְ גִּבּ֑וֹר ה֝וֹדְךָ֗ וַהֲדָרֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: In your splendor ride forth in victory on behalf of truth and humility and justice; may your right hand show your awesome deeds.
passages.sermon:
The psalmist speaks to a mighty and majestic king.
You are splendid and glorious.
Ride out in victory.
Fight for truth.
Fight for humility.
Fight for justice.
Your right hand performs awesome deeds.
passages.original: וַהֲדָ֬רְךָ֨׀ צְלַ֬ח רְכַ֗ב עַֽל־ דְּבַר־ אֱ֭מֶת וְעַנְוָה־ צֶ֑דֶק וְתוֹרְךָ֖ נוֹרָא֣וֹת יְמִינֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Your arrows pierce the hearts of the king’s foes; the nations fall beneath your feet.
passages.sermon:
You are a mighty warrior king.
Your arrows are sharp.
Your arrows strike the hearts of your enemies.
Your enemies are the king’s foes.
Nations fall under your power.
Your enemies fall beneath your feet.
passages.original: חִצֶּ֗יךָ שְׁנ֫וּנִ֥ים עַ֭מִּים תַּחְתֶּ֣יךָ יִפְּל֑וּ בְּ֝לֵ֗ב אוֹיְבֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever, and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom.
passages.sermon:
God rules as King.
God sits on a throne.
God’s throne lasts forever.
God’s throne will never end.
God’s kingdom uses a scepter.
God’s scepter stands for justice.
God’s kingdom is ruled by justice.
passages.original: כִּסְאֲךָ֣ אֱ֭לֹהִים עוֹלָ֣ם וָעֶ֑ד שֵׁ֥בֶט מִ֝ישֹׁ֗ר שֵׁ֣בֶט מַלְכוּתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has anointed you above your companions with the oil of joy.
passages.sermon:
God is the subject.
God loves righteousness.
God hates wickedness.
Because of this, God anointed you.
God, your God, gave you the oil of joy.
God set you above your companions.
passages.original: אָהַ֣בְתָּ צֶּדֶק֮ וַתִּשְׂנָ֫א רֶ֥שַׁע עַל־ כֵּ֤ן׀ מְשָׁחֲךָ֡ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֱ֭לֹהֶיךָ שֶׁ֥מֶן שָׂשׂ֗וֹן מֵֽחֲבֵרֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: All your garments are fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia; from palaces of ivory the harps make you glad.
passages.sermon:
God is the subject of this passage.
God wears garments.
All of God's garments have a fragrance.
The fragrance is myrrh.
The fragrance is also aloes.
The fragrance is also cassia.
Ivory palaces are the setting.
Music comes from these ivory palaces.
Harps play in the ivory palaces.
The music from the harps brings gladness to God.
passages.original: מֹר־ וַאֲהָל֣וֹת קְ֭צִיעוֹת כָּל־ בִּגְדֹתֶ֑יךָ מִֽן־ הֵ֥יכְלֵי שֵׁ֝֗ן מִנִּ֥י שִׂמְּחֽוּךָ׃

passages.text: The daughters of kings are among your honored women; the queen stands at your right hand, adorned with the gold of Ophir.
passages.sermon: The daughters of kings are present among your honored women.\r\nThe queen stands at your right hand.\r\nThe queen wears gold from Ophir.
passages.original: בְּנ֣וֹת מְ֭לָכִים בְּיִקְּרוֹתֶ֑יךָ נִצְּבָ֥ה שֵׁגַ֥ל לִֽ֝ימִינְךָ֗ בְּכֶ֣תֶם אוֹפִֽיר׃

passages.text: Listen, O daughter! Consider and incline your ear: Forget your people and your father’s house, and the king will desire your beauty; bow to him, for he is your lord.
passages.sermon:
A father speaks to his daughter.
He calls her to listen.
He tells her to pay attention.
He asks her to turn her ear to him.
He tells her to forget her people.
He tells her to forget her father’s house.
The king will desire her beauty.
The king is her lord.
She must bow to the king.
passages.original: שִׁמְעִי־ בַ֣ת וּ֭רְאִי וְהַטִּ֣י אָזְנֵ֑ךְ וְשִׁכְחִ֥י עַ֝מֵּ֗ךְ וּבֵ֥ית אָבִֽיךְ׃ וְיִתְאָ֣ו הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ יָפְיֵ֑ךְ כִּי־ ה֥וּא אֲ֝דֹנַ֗יִךְ וְהִשְׁתַּֽחֲוִי־ לֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The Daughter of Tyre will come with a gift; men of wealth will seek your favor.
passages.sermon:
The Daughter of Tyre will come to you.
She will bring a gift.
Wealthy people will seek your favor.
Rich men will desire your approval.
passages.original: וּבַֽת־ צֹ֨ר׀ בְּ֭מִנְחָה פָּנַ֥יִךְ יְחַלּ֗וּ עֲשִׁ֣ירֵי עָֽם׃

passages.text: All glorious is the princess in her chamber; her gown is embroidered with gold.
passages.sermon:
The princess is the daughter of the king.
She is glorious.
She is in her private chamber.
Her gown is beautiful.
Her gown is embroidered with gold.
passages.original: כָּל־ כְּבוּדָּ֣ה בַת־ מֶ֣לֶךְ פְּנִ֑ימָה מִֽמִּשְׁבְּצ֖וֹת זָהָ֣ב לְבוּשָֽׁהּ׃

passages.text: In colorful garments she is led to the king; her virgin companions are brought before you.
passages.sermon:
A princess wears colorful garments.
People lead the princess to the king.
Her virgin companions follow her.
People bring her companions before you.
passages.original: לִרְקָמוֹת֮ תּוּבַ֪ל לַ֫מֶּ֥לֶךְ בְּתוּל֣וֹת אַ֭חֲרֶיהָ רֵעוֹתֶ֑יהָ מ֖וּבָא֣וֹת לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: They are led in with joy and gladness; they enter the palace of the king.
passages.sermon: The women enter the palace of the king.\r\nThey come in with joy.\r\nThey come in with gladness.
passages.original: תּ֭וּבַלְנָה בִּשְׂמָחֹ֣ת וָגִ֑יל תְּ֝בֹאֶ֗ינָה בְּהֵ֣יכַל מֶֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: Your sons will succeed your fathers; you will make them princes throughout the land.
passages.sermon: Your sons will take the place of your fathers.\r\nYou will appoint your sons as princes.\r\nYour sons will rule in every part of the land.
passages.original: תַּ֣חַת אֲ֭בֹתֶיךָ יִהְי֣וּ בָנֶ֑יךָ תְּשִׁיתֵ֥מוֹ לְ֝שָׂרִ֗ים בְּכָל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: I will commemorate your name through all generations; therefore the nations will praise you forever and ever.
passages.sermon: I will remember your name in every generation.\r\nPeople from all nations will praise you forever.\r\nThey will never stop praising you.
passages.original: אַזְכִּ֣ירָה שִׁ֭מְךָ בְּכָל־ דֹּ֣ר וָדֹ֑ר עַל־ כֵּ֥ן עַמִּ֥ים יְ֝הוֹדֻ֗ךָ לְעֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
